# frozen_string_literal: true

# Pragmatic check for the common RFC 5322 "dot-atom" address form.
# Quoted local parts and IP-literal domains are intentionally not supported.
EMAIL_ADDRESS_PATTERN = /\A
  [A-Z0-9!#$%&'*+\/=?^_`{|}~-]+
  (?:\.[A-Z0-9!#$%&'*+\/=?^_`{|}~-]+)*
  @
  (?:[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?\.)+
  [A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?
\z/ix

# Returns true when +value+ looks like an email address.
def email_address?(value)
  return false unless value.is_a?(String)
  return false if value.bytesize > 254

  local = value.rpartition("@").first
  return false if local.bytesize > 64

  EMAIL_ADDRESS_PATTERN.match?(value)
end
